description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which specifies a contract for logging components that can output log data, potentially chaining multiple log nodes together for different logging targets or filtering.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for a logging component that handles the output of log data and supports chaining to other log nodes for complex logging workflows.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable, to be implemented by classes implementing this interface.
